name: The Magical City of Dalaran
summary: A mage in Valanaar sends you from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City, where several mages await your people's arrival. The city offers a place to begin exploring Azeroth, but the lands beyond can be dangerous without preparation and experience.

sections.title: Arrival in Dalaran
sections.body:
Recent events with the cult keep the speaker in Valanaar for now. Several mages wait in Dalaran for your people, so you are sent to the dock outside the lodge. There, you board a skycutter bound for Dalaran City.

When you arrive, speak with Danaaris Stargale. Your people are still making their home in the city, and the country beyond its safety can prove dangerous.

faq.answer: Several mages await your people's arrival in Dalaran. When you reach the city, you are asked to speak with Danaaris Stargale.
You travel from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City aboard the skycutter at the dock outside the lodge.

faq.q: Why is the speaker staying in Valanaar?
faq.answer: Recent events with the cult changed the speaker's plans, so they intend to remain in Valanaar for a time.
The land beyond Dalaran can be dangerous without proper preparation and experience.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you travel from Zephras Isle to join the mages awaiting your people's arrival in Dalaran.
